# Same-device 720p30 seek: RX list phase correction

The reproduced same-device seek stall is fixed in the maintained Flea driver
by [PR #705](https://github.com/ahnhy1324/crystalhd/pull/705). The diagnostic
720p30 case now completes both seeks, its final 900 original pictures, firmware
EOS and normal cleanup. This is a bounded seek result for
[#689](https://github.com/ahnhy1324/crystalhd/issues/689); production PWM remains
disabled, and sustained gating, thermal benefit and endurance remain open.

## Cause and correction

Our earlier successful-stop cleanup reset `rx_list_post_index` to zero while
leaving the hardware alternating-list engine running. After an odd number of
RX transfers, the host consequently restarted on the wrong list. In the frozen
failure, 15 transfers (format plus 14 pictures) precede the first seek. Restart
posts list 0, but list 1 completes first; after the first image, a later list 0
transfer remains pending and the next flush times out. Successful earlier
24 Hz prefixes had an even 14 transfers, hiding this phase mismatch.

The correction removes the two normal-stop index resets. It preserves the
busy-state cleanup, firmware RX sequence reset, timeout/fault ownership and
actual core-start initialization; fatal-error recovery is unchanged. It adds
no engine reset, retry or external application/firmware change. Identical
odd/even stop tests fail on the old source and pass with the correction,
including normal and sanitizer runs and independent review.

## Native comparison

The same input, same-device HANDLE lifecycle, original PTS/generation tags,
24-AU prefix limit, pacing and default YUY2 remain. Forward seek starts at
original IDR AU480 (16 seconds); backward seek returns to AU0 for 900 originals.
The corrected trial retains the frozen RX/TX observer and unchanged PES client,
so the two-line product correction is isolated from diagnostic changes.

Both OFF and finite ON (2 attempts / 5000 ms) have 18 accepted / 14 returned /
4 explicitly cancelled originals
in the first prefix, then 19 / 14 / 5, followed by 900 / 900 / 0. Cancellation
is committed only after successful mode2 flush; prefix pictures never count
toward the final 900 requirement. All 928 pictures per arm match full retained
native YUY2 and source software luma in one primary comparison per acquisition.
Software chroma and
physical display are not qualified.

First RX lists are now 0 → 1 → 0 across decoder generations. All 15, 15 and
902 RX admissions complete; the last count includes format and EOS transfers.
The host observer has no lost records in either arm. All 937 source PES/PTS inputs and the
separate exact 235-byte terminal EOS payload join 938 actual TX calls. These
are copied host observations, not an independent physical DMA readback.

ON records two automatic down/wake/current-FLL cycles, with published sleep
intervals of 96.746956 and 101.057035 ms and FLL12 restored each time. Both
restorations finish before their corresponding prefix flush. This is seek
after gating, not a flush initiated while asleep or sustained gating throughout
the final 900-picture interval. The explicit default-YUY2 setup omits the real
colour setter; its previously recorded ON refusal remains a separate limitation.

Normal same-HANDLE close and exact process resources pass. Complete official
1.3 restoration and ordinary 180-picture/EOS controls before and after pass.
The failed original acquisitions and their separate terminal recoveries remain
unchanged. The existing GStreamer full-device workaround is not removed by
this diagnostic; stock integration coverage remains distinct.
